authority.authority_note: Machine-readable per-sink inventory derived from the exact checked-in js/ tree. It stores no current-main SHA (a mirrored SHA silently re-ages into a false freshness claim); current main is only ever read live from git. Every sink record is re-derived and compared 1:1 by the layer-2 contract test, so a new sink, a removed sink, or a same-count semantic edit fails the test.
authority.scope: innerHTML / outerHTML / insertAdjacentHTML occurrences under js/**.js only.
authority.identity_rule: identity = path :: sinkType :: #occurrence :: statementDigest. Digest is computed over the whitespace-normalised statement, so pure reformatting is tolerated while any real edit changes identity. Line numbers are recorded for humans only and are never identity.
authority.approved_renderer_rule: APPROVED_RENDERER_BOUNDARY is granted only by an entry of APPROVED_RENDERER_CONTRACTS in tests/helpers/dom-sink-scan.cjs: exact owning source + exact declared call sites + a bounded producer list whose returned fragments are re-proven from that source on every run. There is no global same-name helper lookup, no cross-file safety resolution, and no approval from an escape token that merely appears somewhere in a helper body. A returned fragment is proven only when every user-bearing value in it sits inside an escaping boundary (escapeHtml/sanitizeUrl/safeUrl/normalizeUrl/encodeURIComponent/encodeURI) or a numeric/boolean coercion, or is produced by another declared producer; local variables are proven through their exact definitions, and a local definition is never replaced by the on-disk text of the same path.
authority.active_rule: ACTIVE_PRODUCT = the file is loaded by a reachable Product page (index.html, a _redirects canonical page target, an inbound href from another page, or a js-side pages/<name> reference that is not self-referential). Otherwise the surface is DORMANT_UNLINKED, or MOCK_PROTOTYPE when the file header declares a prototype/PoC/mock runtime.
